description: What the chat page may ask the app to do: only show notifications, look for an update, set its zoom (Settings → Appearance) and whether it starts with Windows (Settings → App behaviour), which push-to-talk key to watch (Settings → Voice & audio), what to share as your activity (Settings → App behaviour), the sound of the window being shared, hiding the "sharing your screen" bar, and when the chat is ready to be shown, only from chat.datslok.no.
